svg.title: Checkout lifecycle
svg.desc: The checkout starts when its form is bound and the cart has lines (checkout.started, once per checkout; a later step, a reload or a return from the gateway keeps it). While the shopper fills the form, user.created, user.updated, address.entered, address.updated and payment.selected arrive in any order; a step of a multi-step form that passes its checks sends checkout.continued and opens the next step. A submit, or an express button, starts submitting: the cart is frozen while the form, the cart and the card are checked. A check that fails sends checkout.submitted with valid false and goes back to filling. Checks that pass send checkout.submitted with valid true and place the order. An order not created sends sdk.error, then checkout.failed, and goes back to filling. An order created without a payment_complete_url is paid: order.created, then the shopper is redirected to the next page, which sends order.loaded and order.paid. With one, payment.redirected, then the shopper is redirected to the gateway: paid, the gateway redirects them to the next page; not paid, back to the checkout with the cart kept (payment.failed).

text.tspan: checkout.started: once per checkout in this tab; a paid order ends it and the next one starts anew
An express button pays with the wallet’s details: no form checks (0.4.x requireValidation adds them)
The next page is next-success-url: order.loaded, then order.paid once per order
Without it, an order paid at once goes to the store's order status page: neither event comes
A paid order empties the cart without cart events; at the gateway the cart is kept
Back from the gateway without paying (the Back button): filling again, without events
